name: Dylan's Game Informer
subtitle: A game magazine every day
description: A new issue every day, the same one as on the PC: the cover story is a Switch metroidvania from the last three months, with a big screenshot, why it's worth playing and the store's pitch.
Inside: a quirky indie game of the day (also from the last three months), a big PS5 game that's new or on the way with a countdown, and what's coming up on PS5 and Switch, big games and indies.
features: A new Switch metroidvania every day
A quirky indie game every day
Big PS5 games, new or on the way, with a countdown
Coming up on PS5 and Switch, big and indie
